invariants.preparation: Metadata preparation is non-publishing and leaves version and gitRef changes for review and commit.
invariants.preflight: Publication requires explicit authority, a clean tree, committed package metadata, and an existing gitRef before registry mutation.
invariants.publication: Publish directly to the expected tag, then require bounded exact-version integrity and tag convergence.
invariants.access: Publish the unscoped package with public access.
invariants.retry: An exact version with matching integrity and expected tag is a successful replay; any conflict fails without mutation.
invariants.smoke: Run one non-mutating no-project exact-version --version command after convergence.
